goal: Get web-1's CMDB inventory record including role, zone, criticality, owner, trust_edges_out, and any per-host user overrides to establish the policy baseline for what SSH access is expected.
what_to_summarize: web-1's role, zone, criticality, and owner from CMDB inventory
web-1's trust_edges_out — declared outbound connections to other tiers/hosts
Any per-host users override on web-1
Whether CMDB declares any approved SSH source hosts or bastions for web-1

goal: Get all sshd auth events (Failed password and Accepted) for host web-1 in a ±15 minute window around 2026-07-27T10:40:06Z, extracting from raw message fields: username, source IP, auth method (password vs publickey/cert), port, and timestamps for each event.
what_to_summarize: Every sshd 'Failed password' and 'Accepted' message line for web-1 in the window, with full raw message text
Source IP address extracted from each sshd message
Username extracted from each sshd message (same user across all events or multiple different users)
Auth method: password vs publickey vs certificate (parse the 'Accepted' message token)
Timestamps of each failed and successful event to determine failure cadence and timing pattern
Any session open/close events (pam_unix session opened/closed) to determine session duration and PTY allocation
Prior successful SSH logins to web-1 from the same source IP in the preceding 7 days for baseline comparison

params.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-27T10:25:06Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T10:55:06Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
        AND (
            (process.name == "sshd" AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL)
            OR (message LIKE "*session opened*" OR message LIKE "*session closed*")
        )
| EVAL event_type = CASE(message LIKE "*Accepted*", "auth_accepted", message LIKE "*Failed password*", "auth_failed", message LIKE "*session opened*", "session_opened", message LIKE "*session closed*", "session_closed", "other")
| EVAL auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*", "publickey", message LIKE "*password*", "password", message LIKE "*certificate*", "certificate", "unknown")
| KEEP @timestamp, message, source.ip, user.name, event.outcome, event_type, auth_method, host.name
| SORT @timestamp ASC

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-20T10:40:06Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T10:40:06Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
        AND process.name == "sshd"
        AND event.outcome == "success"
        AND source.ip == "172.18.0.16"
| STATS accepted_count = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY user.name, source.ip, auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*", "publickey", message LIKE "*password*", "password", message LIKE "*certificate*", "certificate", "unknown")
| SORT accepted_count DESC

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-27T10:25:06Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T10:55:06Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
        AND process.name == "sshd"
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| EVAL event_type = CASE(message LIKE "*Accepted*", "auth_accepted", message LIKE "*Failed password*", "auth_failed", "other")
| EVAL auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*", "publickey", message LIKE "*password*", "password", message LIKE "*certificate*", "certificate", "unknown")
| KEEP @timestamp, message, source.ip, user.name, event.outcome, event_type, auth_method, host.name
| SORT @timestamp ASC

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-27T10:25:06Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T10:55:06Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
        AND message LIKE "*pam_unix(sshd:session)*"
        AND (message LIKE "*session opened*" OR message LIKE "*session closed*")
| EVAL session_action = CASE(message LIKE "*session opened*", "opened", message LIKE "*session closed*", "closed", "other")
| EVAL session_user = CASE(message LIKE "*for user svc.deploy*", "svc.deploy", message LIKE "*for user svc.config-mgmt*", "svc.config-mgmt", message LIKE "*for user dev.dana*", "dev.dana", "other")
| KEEP @timestamp, message, session_action, session_user, host.name
| SORT @timestamp ASC

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-27T10:25:06Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T10:55:06Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
        AND (message LIKE "*pty*" OR message LIKE "*PTY*" OR message LIKE "*tty*")
| KEEP @timestamp, message, host.name
| SORT @timestamp ASC

goal: Check authorized_keys files on web-1 for users svc.deploy and svc.config-mgmt to detect any unauthorized key additions that would indicate persistence planted during the SSH sessions.
what_to_summarize: authorized_keys content for svc.deploy on web-1 — number of keys, key types, fingerprints if available
authorized_keys content for svc.config-mgmt on web-1 — number of keys, key types, fingerprints if available
Are there any unexpected or suspicious key entries?
Does authorized_keys file exist for each user or is it absent?

goal: Look up user dev.dana in the identity stub — is this a real user? Are they enabled? What hosts are they authorized on? Are they authorized on web-1?
what_to_summarize: dev.dana user record: enabled status, realm roles, assigned roles
dev.dana authorized_hosts list — which hosts is dev.dana authorized to access?
Is dev.dana specifically authorized on web-1? (can-access dev.dana web-1)
What tier/role are dev.dana's authorized hosts (dev-ws, web, db, etc.)?

goal: Check whether svc.deploy and svc.config-mgmt are authorized to access web-1 per the identity stub, including their enabled status, sudo privileges, and authorized host lists.
what_to_summarize: svc.deploy user record: enabled, realm roles, authorized_hosts, sudo on web-1
svc.config-mgmt user record: enabled, realm roles, authorized_hosts, sudo on web-1
can-access result for svc.deploy on web-1 (authorized yes/no, via policy or override, sudo)
can-access result for svc.config-mgmt on web-1 (authorized yes/no, via policy or override, sudo)

goal: Identify what hosts are at IP addresses 172.18.0.16, 172.18.0.9, and 172.18.0.24 by querying CMDB inventory — list all hosts and find matches by IP, returning their role, zone, criticality, and trust_edges_out.
what_to_summarize: Which CMDB host has IP 172.18.0.16 — its name, role, zone, criticality, trust_edges_out
Which CMDB host has IP 172.18.0.9 — its name, role, zone, criticality, trust_edges_out
Which CMDB host has IP 172.18.0.24 — its name, role, zone, criticality, trust_edges_out
Are any of these hosts declared as approved SSH sources or bastions for web-1?

params.query:
FROM logs-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-27T00:00:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T23:59:59Z"
        AND (source.ip == "172.18.0.16" OR client.ip == "172.18.0.16" OR host.ip == "172.18.0.16"
             OR source.ip == "172.18.0.9" OR client.ip == "172.18.0.9" OR host.ip == "172.18.0.9"
             OR source.ip == "172.18.0.24" OR client.ip == "172.18.0.24" OR host.ip == "172.18.0.24")
| STATS events = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY host.name, source.ip, client.ip, host.ip, data_stream.dataset
| SORT events DESC
